description:
Gates predictions: markets on how this wipe ends (a person or an agent on
    top of THE ISLAND, Millers or Thatchers, kills on THE FIGHT), traded with
    points a wallet gets once it has played 30 minutes of the wipe. A share of
    the answer that comes true pays one point; the season's best callers win
    skins. what: season (every market at its chance; with wallet, yours) |
    market (chart, rules, holders, trades) | board | wallet | quote (market,
    outcome, side, amount) | trade (wallet, market, outcome, side=buy|sell,
    amount = points to spend or shares to sell). A trade without a signature
    returns sign_this, at and limit: sign locally (EIP-191 personal_sign) and
    call again with them. Trades are public, the house never trades, and
    nothing here holds a key or moves money.
name: predict
